hotels.title: Stylish Brisbane Escape on Astor Terrace Moments from Queen Street Mall
hotels.description: Step into the heart of Brisbane with a stay at this contemporary urban escape. Ideally positioned on Astor Terrace, you'll be within arm's reach of the bustling Queen Street Mall, Fortitude Valley, and the tranquil Botanic Gardens and Roma Street Parklands - perfect for a serene afternoon walk. Further afield, head across the river to explore South Bank or unwind in the hotel's onsite cafe and bar for a warm tea or coffee and a flaky pastry.
